No page listed one spell at two ranks, so 'Show all spell ranks' was off or the character knew one rank; ranksSeen is the highest rank known, not the full set.
Page headings the reader could not resolve to a tab, because a hover tooltip stood over them: Bal, Tiger's Fury. Their entries are in this file without a tab and say so in source.note.
Entries with a source note were read from a clipped row or a search page; check the crop before quoting them.
